SELECT g.id AS guest_id, g.party_id, g.user_id, g.status AS guest_status, g.role
FROM guests g
JOIN parties p ON p.id = g.party_id
WHERE g.join_token = $1
  AND g.status = 'active'
  AND p.status = 'active'
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  v.party_can_pay,
  v.subtotal_required     AS party_subtotal,
  v.tip_percent,
  COALESCE(sel.guest_subtotal, 0)    AS guest_subtotal_cents,
  COALESCE(pay.total_paid, 0)        AS amount_paid_cents,
  p.restaurant_name
FROM party_validation_view v
JOIN parties p ON p.id = v.party_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT SUM(s.quantity * i.unit_price_cents) AS guest_subtotal
  FROM selections s JOIN items i ON i.id = s.item_id
  WHERE s.guest_id = $2::uuid
) sel ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT SUM(amount_paid_cents) AS total_paid
  FROM payments WHERE guest_id = $2::uuid
) pay ON TRUE
WHERE v.party_id = $1::uuid

INSERT INTO closures (party_id, guest_id, subtotal_cents, tip_cents, total_cents, paid_cents)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3, $4, $5, $6)
ON CONFLICT (guest_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, closed_at

UPDATE guests SET status = 'closed', closed_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1::uuid

-- Update shared-people analytics for logged-in users
DO $$
DECLARE
  v_user_id   UUID := $1::uuid;
  v_party_id  UUID := $2::uuid;
  v_other_id  UUID;
BEGIN
  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF;
  FOR v_other_id IN
    SELECT DISTINCT g.user_id
    FROM guests g
    WHERE g.party_id = v_party_id
      AND g.user_id IS NOT NULL
      AND g.user_id != v_user_id
  LOOP
    INSERT INTO user_shared_people (user_id, other_user_id, shared_party_count, last_shared_at)
    VALUES (v_user_id, v_other_id, 1, NOW())
    ON CONFLICT (user_id, other_user_id) DO UPDATE
      SET shared_party_count = user_shared_people.shared_party_count + 1,
          last_shared_at     = NOW();
  END LOOP;
END $$
